title: GCP Compute Engine Web Application Server
description: Ubuntu Linux VM running Nginx with reserved static external IP, shielded VM security features, and guarded firewall rules

server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Hostname and name prefix applied to the instance resources

gcp_project_id.title: GCP Project ID
gcp_project_id.description: GCP project ID where compute resources will be created

network_name.title: VPC Network Name
network_name.description: Name of the VPC network the instance attaches to (typically an output of the GCP VPC template)

subnet_self_link.title: Subnet Self-Link
subnet_self_link.description: Self-link URI of the subnetwork to attach the instance to (typically an output of the GCP VPC template)

zone.title: GCP Zone
zone.description: GCP zone in which to provision the instance

region.title: GCP Region
region.description: GCP region for the reserved static IP

allocated_storage_gb.title: Boot Disk Storage (GB)
allocated_storage_gb.description: Boot disk storage capacity in Gigabytes

boot_image.title: Boot Disk Image
boot_image.description: Boot disk operating system image family

service_account_email.title: Instance Service Account
service_account_email.description: Service account email attached to the instance (leave blank for compute default)

preemptible.title: Preemptible Instance
preemptible.description: Run the instance as preemptible (spot) for cost savings on ephemeral workloads

allowed_ssh_cidrs.title: Allowed SSH CIDRs
allowed_ssh_cidrs.description: Permitted IPv4 network blocks for SSH administrative access. Empty list disables inbound SSH.
